elements.description:
A small badge of citation counts by kind – Publications, Supporting, Mentioning, Contrasting – with a tooltip
that says what each means, and an optional link to the details.

properties.name: counts
properties.description: Each kind's count by id: { publications: 522, supporting: 29 … }; a kind without one shows 0

properties.name: rows
properties.default: [ { id: "publications", label: "Publications", icon: "document", tone: "neutral", meaning: "publications that cite this work" }, { id: "supporting", label: "Supporting", icon: "supporting", tone: "success", meaning: "cites this work as evidence for its claim" }, { id: "mentioning", label: "Mentioning", icon: "mentioning", tone: "neutral", meaning: "refers to this work without taking a side" }, { id: "contrasting", label: "Contrasting", icon: "contrasting", tone: "info", meaning: "reports findings that question or disagree with it" }, ]
properties.description: The kinds, in order; by default Publications, Supporting, Mentioning and Contrasting

properties.name: layout
properties.description: "labelled": name, mark and count; "compact": the mark and the count

properties.name: source
properties.description: A source's name shown on top, e.g. your index's name; none by default

properties.name: logo
properties.description: A logo shown on top instead of `source` (cloned); give it an accessible name, or set `source` too

properties.name: label
properties.description: What the counts are, for the badge's name when there's no `source`

properties.name: href
properties.description: Where the details are – the badge becomes a link

properties.name: openable
properties.description: Without `href`, makes the badge a button that fires tc-open

properties.name: detailsLabel
properties.description: The link's hint in the tooltip

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open
events.description: The badge was opened (clicked, or Enter on it) with `href` or `openable` ({ href }: CitationOpen); cancelable – prevented, a link isn't followed

functions.name: defaultCitationRows
functions.description: The kinds shown when the page gives none

props.name: onOpen
props.description: The badge was opened (with `href` or `openable`); return false to stop a link being followed

changelog: **`tc-citation-badge`:** an embeddable badge of citation tallies – publications, supporting, mentioning and contrasting. - **Layouts:** labelled or compact. - **Details:** a tooltip says what each type means, and an optional link goes to more. No third-party branding.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
